\subsection*{Gaussian Space --- Noise --- Boolean Bounds: Results}

\begin{lemma}[Two-function hypercontractive inequality for small offset]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.boolean_two_function_smallOffset}
\label{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.boolean_two_function_smallOffset}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.general_two_function_hypercontractivity, BooleanAnalysis.expect, BooleanAnalysis.innerProduct, BooleanAnalysis.noiseOp}
\difficulty{4}
Let $n$ be a natural number, and let $r,s,\rho\in\mathbb R$ satisfy $r>0$, $s>0$,
$r\le1$, $rs\le1$, $0\le\rho\le1$, and $\rho^2\le rs$. For any real-valued functions
$f,g$ on $\{0,1\}^n$, their uniform inner product with the noise operator applied to $g$
satisfies
\[
\langle f,T_\rho g\rangle\le
\bigl(\E|f|^{1+r}\bigr)^{1/(1+r)}\bigl(\E|g|^{1+s}\bigr)^{1/(1+s)}.
\]
\end{lemma}
